Argentina is one of the world's largest producers of beef.

Uruguay gets a very high share of its electricity from renewable energy sources.

Gauchos traditionally decorate their belts with silver coins as a sign of pride.
Guanacos, wild relatives of the llama, share the Patagonian grasslands with cattle and sheep.

Gauchos build a deep bond of trust with their horses over years of riding together.

Amazon Rainforest. The Amazon is the largest rainforest on Earth, and more than half of it is in Brazil.
Andes Mountains. The Andes run down the whole west side of South America — the longest mountain range in the world.
Atacama Desert. The Atacama Desert in Chile is the driest place on Earth — some spots have never recorded rain.

Llama. People in the Andes have used llamas to carry loads for thousands of years.

Chinchilla. Chinchillas have the thickest fur of any land animal, to survive cold mountain nights.
